caption: The drawing shows a suspended wooden structure, resembling a crown or lantern form, hung by a brown string or cord from above. The main body consists of a circular ring at the base, with four curved supports rising upward, meeting at the top center. The wood of the structure is depicted in faded, pale blue-green, with patches of paint chipping off to reveal brown areas underneath, suggesting weathering and age. Along the inner curve of each support is a thin red line following the wood’s contour. Atop the apex of the structure, a small, stylized bird figure—painted in a similar pale blue-green with a red-orange spot on its chest—appears to be perched, tied to the supporting cord. Three small, simplified penguin-like figures, painted in the same colors as the main structure, are positioned on the inner rim of the circular base, facing inward. The background is plain and cream-colored, emphasizing the objects and their colors with no additional context or scenery. The drawing includes a small signature or inscription in the bottom right corner.
title: One painted, Wooden Candelabrum, with Dove
